items.title: Dixit Jani on X: "Just tried Bitchord, and I'm genuinely liking it! Open-source music player with Lossless audio playback support. A clean experience for music lovers! ️"
Bezplatná aplikace BitChord dělá vše, co YouTube Music, jen lépe. Je bez reklam, bez předplatného a funguje i bez Googlu
BitChord is an open source YouTube Music alternative that puts Google to shame
Noah Cat on X: "No, this is not Apple Music. This is a free open-source Android app called BitChord. I LOVE ANDROID."
I replaced YouTube Music with Metrolist to get a cleaner open source listening interface
